description:
During your upkeep, activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Black Carriage, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Black Carriage by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Black Carriage ability, untapping it.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.
